theorems.statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {H : Type*} [CommRing H] [HopfAlgebra k H] (K : Subalgebra k H) (hΔ : (∀ x ∈ K, Coalgebra.comul (R := k) x ∈ Submodule.span k {t : TensorProduct k H H | ∃ a ∈ K, ∃ b ∈ K, t = TensorProduct.tmul k a b})) {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Bialgebra k B] (q : BialgHom k H B) (hker : (RingHom.ker (q : H →+* B) = Ideal.span {x : H | x ∈ K ∧ Coalgebra.counit (R := k) x = 0})), K ≤ HopfAlgebra.hopfKer q
